title: Found Parcels after Delivery Claims Compensation: Charge Authorization by the Customer
content:
**Rule.** When a parcel compensated on a Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim turns up, the customer either sends it back with a prepaid label within the claim type's found-item return window, in calendar days, or keeps it and is charged the found-parcel charge, recorded as a found parcel kept.

Keeping the parcel and paying for it is the customer's own decision: the customer authorizes the found-parcel charge personally, for the order line whose units they keep, and the charge goes to the original card. A found-parcel charge is booked only while the claim is in status resolved. A found-parcel charge is not taken until the compensation owed on each of the customer's other approved claims has been booked.

The rule concerns parcels compensated on Delivery Claims of those two types.

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| Who decides to keep the parcel | the customer |
| Who authorizes the charge | the customer personally |
| What the charge is for | the order line whose units the customer keeps |
| Where the charge goes | the original card |
| Claim status in which the charge is booked | resolved |
| Before the charge is taken | the compensation owed on each of the customer's other approved claims has been booked |

## Customer action: `authorize_found_parcel_charge_f3b6f0d4`

**Situation of use and capability.** The customer authorizes the charge to their original card for items they keep from a parcel that was compensated as undelivered and has turned up. One call records a single charge on the claim for one order line: the number of units kept and the amount the customer agrees to be charged, dated today, taken from the card the order was paid with. The claim itself is not otherwise changed. The recorded charge shows on the claim as value recovered for a found parcel kept.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it for the customer with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | the claim number of the customer's Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim, as the representative reads it to the customer from the claim record | identifier |
| `booked_line_id` | the order line reference number (the identifier of the booked order line) whose items the customer keeps, as the representative reads it from the claim's compensation record | identifier |
| `quantity` | how many units of that line the customer keeps | a whole number, at least 1 |
| `amount_usd` | the amount the customer authorizes to be charged, in USD, as the representative states it; recorded on the claim as value recovered | a positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places (to the nearest cent, on the final figure) |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `charge_id` (the reference of the recorded charge), `claim_id` (the claim number), `booked_line_id` (the order line kept), `quantity` (units kept), `amount_charged_usd` (the amount taken from the card, USD with 2 decimal places) and `charged_on` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving this receipt means the charge has been authorized and recorded.
